description:
Monitors K3s cluster using Kube-Prometheus. Shows overall cluster CPU / Memory / Filesystem usage as well as individual pod, containers, systemd services statistics. Uses cAdvisor metrics + node metrics for top level stats.

Origin from  dashboard: 
15282 (k8s-rke-cluster-monitoring),
8721(K8s RKE cluster monitoring) and will be compatible with k3s
title: K3S cluster monitoring with node metrics
